card.name: The word if starting a condition
card.fires_on: The word "if" (rarely "on" or "line") that opens a conditional clause after an instruction step, e.g. "if necessary" or "If it is still low". It appears in how-to steps and dosing directions.

modes.label: If after an instruction
modes.description: "If" begins a conditional follow-up clause right after a step or sentence.
modes.example: recheck blood sugar in 15 minutes.<< If>> it is still low, give your child

modes.label: Mid-sentence if
modes.description: "if" joins a condition onto the step just given, such as "if necessary" or "if needed".
modes.example: making your coughs slightly louder<< if>> necessary, until your throat is clear.

modes.label: Other branching words
modes.description: Occasional words like "on" or "line" in phrases about moving to a next step.
modes.example: move<< on>> to the others later.
